verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a built-in Research Agent that users delegate tasks to in conversation. The docs show it filtering and exporting sources, saving papers, generating figures, drafting slides and adding extraction columns on request. Skills, effort levels and collaborative sessions add depth. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the agent delegation workflow; community reports concern older summarization and search quality, not the agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: filter and export your sources, save papers to your Library, generate figures, and draft slides, all without leaving the conversation
To add a column, simply tell the research agent what column(s) you'd like to add.
A skill is a set of instructions you can hand to Elicit's agent so it approaches a task a particular way.
the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need
